print('frames:', fs.count)
def boxes(fr):
    res = {'Y':[], 'sweep':[], 'blob':[]}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rmin=min(p[0] for p in b); rmax=max(p[0] for p in b)
        cmin=min(p[1] for p in b); cmax=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='Y': res['Y'].append((rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax))
        elif n['color']=='b':
            if rmin>=40 and rmax<=48: res['sweep'].append((rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax))
            elif rmin>=49: res['blob'].append((rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax))
    return res
for i in range(fs.count):
    print(i, boxes(fs.at(i)))
print('diff:', fs.diff(before=0, after=-1, max_changes=8))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def boxes(fr):
    res = {'Y':[], 'sweep':[], 'blob':[]}
